title: token-of-esteem
description: A press your agent can commission: a funny, personalized printed booklet, mailed as a gift.
summary: A press your agent can commission: a funny, personalized printed booklet, mailed as a gift.
offersHint: A press your agent can commission: a funny, personalized printed booklet, mailed as a gift. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.tokenofesteem.com/v1/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer toe_live_... account token, issued at tokenofesteem.com/account. Use toe_test_... for the free sandbox. No account? See the tokenless 402 path at tokenofesteem.com/for-agents.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer toe_live_... account token, issued at tokenofesteem.com/account. Use toe_test_... for the free sandbox. No account? See the tokenless 402 path at tokenofesteem.com/for-agents.

toolsPreview.name: list_voices
toolsPreview.description: List the three comedic voices (Hype Man, Best Friend Roast, Conspiracy Theorist) and the cover image model each prefers. Free, no side effects. Call this first to pick a voice.

toolsPreview.name: list_formats
toolsPreview.description: List supported booklet formats. There is one today: manual_v1, a 16-page booklet. Free, no side effects.

toolsPreview.name: list_image_models
toolsPreview.description: List supported cover image models and their per-call cost. Free, no side effects.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Compute the exact total for a hypothetical gift (format, voice, image model, ship_to) before you commit. Free, no order is created. Call before create_gift so you know the charge.

toolsPreview.name: validate_brief
toolsPreview.description: Run the content policy on a brief without charging or ordering. Free. Call before create_gift so a refusal surfaces early. A booklet that would wound the recipient is refused here, not at charge time.

toolsPreview.name: create_gift
toolsPreview.description: Place the order: write, print, and mail the booklet. CHARGES the buyer. The recipient is whoever you name in recipient, which may be your own user. Idempotent on idempotency_key for 24 hours. Pass shared_payment_token to pay tokenlessly, or omit it to charge the account's saved card.

toolsPreview.name: get_gift
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a gift by gift_id and return its full resource: status, voice, format, pricing, the recipient, and fulfillment (Lulu job id, carrier, tracking URL, estimated delivery). Free and read-only. Use it to poll progress after create_gift: status advances through the pipeline to shipped then delivered, or ends at held, refused, cancelled, or failed.

toolsPreview.name: list_gifts
toolsPreview.description: Paginated list of gifts on the account, with optional status and date filters. Free.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_gift
toolsPreview.description: Cancel an in-flight gift and receive the refund amount. Free. Only possible before the booklet goes to print; once printing has started it fails with cancel_too_late. Pass the gift_id from create_gift and an optional reason for your records.

toolsPreview.name: get_account
toolsPreview.description: Return this account's spending caps and month-to-date spend. Free. Use it to confirm budget before create_gift.

toolsPreview.name: list_recipients
toolsPreview.description: Return the account's saved recipients (address book). Free. Reuse a recipient_id in create_gift instead of re-entering an address.

toolsPreview.name: create_setup_link
toolsPreview.description: Return a hosted Stripe link for the buyer to save a card or wallet to the account. After that, create_gift without a shared_payment_token charges the saved card.
